title: Coco Condo with Pool and Generator in Rincon
description: Escape to paradise in this charming two-bedroom apartment, conveniently located in the heart of Rincón. Perfect for couples or families, this cozy retreat offers a home away from home with all the comforts of modern living. Relax on the patio, soak up the sun by the pool, or explore the stunning beaches, restaurants, bars, and downtown area just minutes away. Experience the true essence of Puerto Rico in this idyllic location.The spaceExperience the best of Rincón from this ideally situated two-bedroom, one-bathroom apartment, located just minutes from the area’s finest beaches. You'll be steps away from local bakeries and convenient stores, making it easy to enjoy everything the town has to offer.This apartment features a designated parking spot, a balcony, a fully-equipped kitchen, and a generator that powers recreational areas and inside of the apartment, ensuring comfort and convenience throughout your stay. Book your stay today and enjoy a memorable Rincón getaway!Guest accessGuests will enjoy the convenience of self-check-in. We’ll provide a detailed guide containing all the information you need for a smooth arrival and stay. This guide includes instructions on how to retrieve the key from the lockbox and access the apartment.We’re always available if you need any assistance during your stay. Rest assured, we’re here to help whenever you need us!Other things to notePlease note that while we don't have direct beach access, the nearest beach is just a 4-minute drive away. The pool is shared with other units in the condominium.Events and/or parties are not allowed.Comfortably fits a family of five. Up to two additional guests may sleep in an extendable sofa or inflatable bed. Additional charges will apply for more than 5 guests. We appreciate your understanding and cooperation!1. No Smoking Inside – A $250 fine will be applied if smoking is detected inside the apartment, plus any additional costs for cleaning supplies and staff needed to restore the unit. 2. Checkout Time is 11:00 AM – Guests who remain in the property past 11:00 AM will be charged $150 per additional hour unless previously arranged. 3. No Parties or Loud Gatherings – Unauthorized parties or excessive noise are strictly prohibited. Violations will result in immediate eviction and an additional fine of $500. 4. Only Registered Guests Allowed – Only guests listed on the reservation are allowed on the property. Unregistered visitors may result in a penalty or cancellation of the stay. 5. Respect for Property and Neighbors – Please treat the space with care and be mindful of noise, especially during quiet hours (10:00 PM to 8:00 AM). Any damage caused will be the guest’s responsibility.

title: Villa del Sol - Oceanfront Rincon Retreat w Pool
description: Welcome to Villa del Sol, a beautifully remodeled 2,080-square-foot oceanfront retreat located in one of the most stunning complexes in Rincón. description: La Casa del Surfer is in Rincón, on the popular Highway 413, "Road to Happiness." Less than 2 km to Maria's, Domes & Tres Palmas (surf breaks) and Steps Beach Marine Reserve for snorkeling. Walk to beaches, downtown plaza, restaurants & bars. Two bedrooms, one bathroom casita. One queen bedroom with A/C. The second bedroom has a twin bed and no A/C. Fully equipped kitchen, living room, front and back patio, large yard & free parking on gated property. Two persons maximum.The spacePLEASE READ FIRST ! This listing is for an individual, two bedrooms, one bathroom ( no hot water), fully equipped home. This home is set up for guests and is not shared with the host or any additional guests. The master bedroom includes a queen bed, two nightstands, clothing rack, floor fan and window A/C unit. The second bedroom includes a twin bed, night stands, fan, and closet. It is not equipped with an A/C unit.The space is clean and cozy, with a surf house feel. Included: fresh linens, bath & beach towels, and access to beach equipment (items available may vary). Stable Wi-fi suitable for a remote work.This unit is NOT shared with other guests or the host. The unit is located on a half acre property. Host lives in a separate house on the property and will give guests total privacy during their stay. You can have as little or as much interaction with them as you wish. If you are up for it, we pride ourselves in not only offering accommodation, but also a warm welcome and original hosting experience. Host is always available and happy to answer any questions you may have, or offer local recommendations through a phone call or a text message.After a day in the sun, La Casa del Surfer is a peaceful place to relax while listening to the waves break on the shore and the coqui chirp in the creek. Get insider tips from your host, learn to surf, indulge in the culture, listen to live music, disconnect and enjoy the experience!We think you'll love this place if:- You are relaxed, adventurous, and enthusiastic.- You love catching waves or just good vibes.- You appreciate a nice touch; like waking up to a coffee and water supply after a long day of traveling and arriving late at night.- You enjoy meeting hosts and exchanging feel-good stories on your travels.- You love relaxing on the porch with the sounds of nature after a long beach day.- You appreciate places with unique character and art by local artists.You may want to consider other options if:- You enjoy luxury.- You would like to party at your rental.- You are not comfortable with convenient simplicity.- You want 100% privacy in a secluded place. - You enjoy watching tv on your vacation.- You prefer newly renovated unit embellished by generic department store decorations.Guest accessGuests have access to a full house on the private property with two bedrooms (one with a queen bed and one with a twin bed), fully equipped kitchen (ready for cooking), living room, bathroom, front and back patio, outdoor areas, plenty of parking. Guests have access to basic cleaning supplies such as paper towels, kitchen towels, cleaning solution, extra trash bags, broom, mop, etc. Also available are beach chairs, cooler, umbrella, and snorkeling gear, some of these upon request and at no additional charge. Checkin: After 3:00pm Checkout: NoonOther things to noteACTIVITIES * Beginner Surf Lessons (group) - $80/person (group), $110/person (individual)

description: Feel at home in this luxurious beachfront villa, just steps from the ocean right outside your front door. So close, you can open the windows and enjoy the refreshing breeze and soothing sound of the waves. Relax and fully embrace the beachside lifestyle. Capture unforgettable moments as you take in stunning sunsets from the balcony or the soft sand below. This private community offers a pool & basketball court. The villa is equipped with solar panels, providing reliable energy for your comfort.Other things to noteImportant Advisory on Utilities:Before booking your stay, please read and acknowledge the following situation on the Puerto Rico government run utilities. In Puerto Rico, utilities are public run companies and unfortunately, they are suboptimally run. Furthermore, after a string of destructive hurricanes, the infrastructure is somewhat frangile. The apartment complex at Puntas Del Mar offers many amenities but back-up generators or water reservoirs are not some of them. Since such infrastructure issues are outside our control as hosts, we cannot be held liable for the interruption of power or water utilities. We do, however understand the impact of such event on a stay. If an outage lasts longer than 24 hours, we would allow an early check out and work with AirBnB to get you refunded the remainder of the stay. We truly wished a disclaimer like this one wouldn't be necessary, however that is the reality of the island utilities. Please do not leave negative reviews based on an outage, it is outside the scope of the property's review. If you feel you disagree or if you know you will be inclined to give a poor review in this situation, please refrain from booking. Please know that we are here to help and to make your stay as wonderful as possible.
